meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: Connect to and control Google Chrome browser using agent-browser with CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). Use when the user wants to automate their existing Chrome browser, see browser actions in real-time, or needs to control the Chrome instance they're already using. Handles installation, setup, connecting via remote debugging, and all browser automation tasks with live visual feedback.

copy.tagline: 用真实浏览器自动执行网页操作并实时查看反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制Chrome浏览器完成重复网页操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate web tasks in your real Chrome browser with live visual feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control Chrome programmatically for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 agent-browser 连接你正在使用的 Chrome 浏览器，自动检查并安装所需依赖，然后执行打开网页、填写表单、点击、截图等操作，所有动作都实时显示在你的浏览器窗口里。
howto.when: 当你提出要自动化操作现有 Chrome 浏览器、想实时看到浏览器动作，或需要控制正在使用的 Chrome 实例时触发。每次自动化前还会先运行依赖安装检查。

say.text: 用 Chrome 打开小红书，搜索 labubu 并截图
say.note: Claude 会连接你的 Chrome，执行搜索并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我在 Chrome 里自动填写这个登录表单
say.note: Claude 会定位表单元素并填入内容。

say.text: 看看我当前 Chrome 页面有什么可点的
say.note: Claude 会生成可交互元素快照并展示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will connect to your running Chrome browser via agent-browser (CDP), auto-check and install dependencies, then perform actions like opening pages, filling forms, clicking, and taking screenshots. All actions are visible in your browser in real time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate your existing Chrome browser, want to see browser actions in real-time, or need to control the Chrome instance you're already using. An auto-install dependency check runs before any automation.

say_en.text: Open Xiaohongshu in Chrome, search labubu, and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will connect, search, and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Help me fill in this login form in Chrome automatically.
say_en.note: Claude will locate fields and fill them.

say_en.text: Show me what's clickable on my current Chrome page.
say_en.note: Claude will snapshot interactive elements and display them.
